official_sources.version_note: The server tag is annotated: its tag object is not the peeled commit. Reviewed locale/DT API files are unchanged in the v4.35.0..v4.35.2 source diff. Existing local old checkouts were not used as 4.35 evidence.

install_contract.upload: Original approved UTF-8 PO, not MO or locale ZIP
install_contract.language: Extracted from the PO Language header; zh-Hant is preserved, not normalized to zh_Hant.
install_contract.binding: Exact released documentTemplateUuid and tenant; code is unique within that DT. Server does not validate source hashes or all message placeholders.

generation_contract.template_reference: documentTemplateUuid, resolved from the actual installed template; not localeUuid or a guessed documentTemplateId alias
generation_contract.language_resolution: Server validates that the selected DT has that code, then supplies locale UUID/code/name/timestamps to Worker. Missing language or base language is allowed but does not request Chinese.
generation_contract.current_tool_gap: The unchanged Tool create_document request was exercised offline and omits language. Do not use it to accept the new shared English DT's Chinese output until the adapter explicitly forwards language.

ui_contract_source_review_only.selection: Imported locales enable the document Language selector; it shows codes such as en and zh-Hant.
ui_contract_source_review_only.default: Project documentTemplateLanguage, otherwise DT.language; independent of UI/KM language.
ui_contract_source_review_only.switching_template: Resets format and document language to the new DT base; select/save zh-Hant again.
ui_contract_source_review_only.metadata: Template/format names and template description remain metadata text, not automatically translated by PO.

update_and_version_guards.locale_update: No locale PUT in reviewed 4.35 routes. Same-code POST is rejected; delete/create replacement is a distinct destructive operation, not authorized by this rehearsal.
update_and_version_guards.template_upgrade: New template versions and basedOn drafts do not copy locales. Attach the approved PO to the new installed UUID.
update_and_version_guards.template_reimport: Same-coordinate bundle replacement deletes the previous DT; locale foreign key cascades delete. Never overwrite a published coordinate to update this experiment.
update_and_version_guards.translation_versions: Chinese repo versions/tags identify PO revisions independently; the reviewed DT-locale API itself has no version field.
update_and_version_guards.deployment_default: New immutable DT version plus matching PO; reject any automatic delete/overwrite. Preserve the old installed template/locale for rollback.

preview_cache_risk_not_runtime_reproduce.source_finding: Preview cache matching/hash lacks locale UUID/update stamp or PO hash; locale create/delete does not immediately invalidate preview.
preview_cache_risk_not_runtime_reproduce.boundary: Fresh POST /documents creates a new UUID/job without reading the preview cache. Ordinary project-settings updates also clean that project's temporary documents, but no project was changed here.
preview_cache_risk_not_runtime_reproduce.acceptance_rule: Use freshly generated, downloaded documents to verify a PO change. A new DT UUID separates previews. Do not infer content-cache expiry from a presigned URL's lifetime.

offline_checks.scope: Own source-derived Python protocol rehearsal, not execution of the Haskell Server parser, database, S3, permission checks or UI.

safe_sequence_after_separate_release_aut: Assign a new immutable version and validate the source/ZIP/PO pair; experimental 0.3.78 is not authorized for installation.
Install the new DT without replacing an existing coordinate; resolve its returned UUID.
Check existing locale codes and stop on duplicates; attach the approved PO using name and poContent.
Download the stored PO and verify bytes/hash plus returned code before accepting installation.
Generate fresh PDF/Word with explicit zh-Hant and verify; only then switch a project's DT/format/document language under approved rollout.
